title: Open compact-support composition on the pullback tower
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and use ordinary unbounded derived categories of small etale module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $f:X\to S$ be separated, finite type and compactifiable, $u:U\hookrightarrow S$ open, and $X,U,S,X_U=X\times_S U$ Noetherian. Put $v:X_U\to X$ and $f_U:X_U\to U$ for the projections. Choose any compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,r:\overline X\to S)$ and its pullback $c_U=(j_U:X_U\hookrightarrow\overline X_U,r_U:\overline X_U\to U)$, and put $b:\overline X_U\hookrightarrow\overline X$. Write $J,J',B,V,L$ for exact derived extension by zero along $j,j_U,b,v,u$, and $P=Rr_*$, $Q=Rr_{U*}$. The open-extension adjunctions are those of [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction]; their composition comparisons are those of [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition]. Let $a_0:j_{U!}b_!\cong v_!j_!$ be the left-adjoint comparison conjugate to the inverse-image square isomorphism $j^*v^*\cong b^*j_U^*$. Define $a:J'B\cong VJ$ by applying these exact functors termwise and the canonical derived composition comparisons. Let $t:JP\cong Rf_!$ and $t':J'Q\cong Rf_{U!}$ be the model-to-chosen comparisons of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let $\delta:VRf_!\cong Rf_{U!}L$ be the normalized composition comparison obtained by the specified compact-support composition comparisons, the equality $vf=f_Uu$, and the identity-proper compactifications of the opens. Let $\Gamma:QL\to BP$ be the specified proper/open interchange in that tower. For every $M\in D(X_{U,\mathrm{et}},A)$, $\delta_M^{-1}$ equals $L((t'_M)^{-1})$, followed by $\Gamma_{J'M}$, followed by $P(a_M)$, followed by $t_{VM}$. This identity concerns composition before evaluation counits or proper base-change exchange.

proof.text: Apply the source-open composition normalization to v=pullback.fst f u, f and c. This identifies the first composition comparison with the inverse derived open-composition factor and the comparison for c.precomp v.

Expand the second comparison by unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso_tower with outer compactification (u,id) and inner compactification (c.precomp v).copy(pullback.condition.symm). The two terminal model comparisons cancel after the congruence isomorphism. The inner restricted model is the pullback compactification.

The proved derived direct-image right-unit identity removes the identity proper factor. Naturality moves its inverse through the tower exchange, and its inverse/hom cancel. Transport the two literal pullback-open presentations by equality, using the proved heterogeneous congruence lemma. The two remaining open-composition factors and the congruence descend to mapDerivedCategorySquareIso, by preservation of composition and inverse under exact derived descent. This gives the asserted formula before applying any evaluation counit.

theorem openExchange_tower
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X U S : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ S} (u : U ⟶ S)
    [IsOpenImmersion u] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian S]
    [IsNoetherian (pullback f u)] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] [HasCompactification f]
    (c : Compactification f) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A (pullback f u)) :
    let δ :=
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight
            (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoOfIsOpenImmersion A (pullback.fst f u)).symm
            (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) ≪≫
          unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A (pullback.fst f u) f ≪≫
          unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr A (pullback.condition) ≪≫
          (unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A (pullback.snd f u) u).symm ≪≫
          Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
            (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd f u))
            (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoOfIsOpenImmersion A u)
    let cs := c.ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f u)
    let _sq := c.isPullback_i_ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f u)
    let a := (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
      ((openImmersionLowerShriekComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          cs.i (pullback.fst c.g u)).symm ≪≫
        eqToIso (by
          simp only [cs, Compactification.ofIsPullback_i_fst]) ≪≫
        openImmersionLowerShriekComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (pullback.fst f u) c.i)).hom
    δ.inv.app M =
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A cs).inv.app M) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriekLowerStarExchange (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g u).flip).app
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) cs.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).map (a.app M) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A c).hom.app
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (pullback.fst f u)).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)
